description: This file contains the implementation of a HostValidator class responsible for validating hostnames against a set of allowed or blocked addresses, including resolving hostnames to IP addresses and checking for special address types like loopback, site-local, and multicast. It is part of a messaging connectivity validation module within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: HostValidator
classes.description: Final class that performs hostname validation against allowed and blocked address lists, resolving hostnames, and checking for special IP address types.

classes.name: HostValidationResult
classes.description: Nested static class representing the outcome of hostname validation, including methods to generate specific validation results and exceptions.

classes.name: AddressResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving hostnames to IP addresses.

methods.name: HostValidator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the validator with configuration, logging, and optional custom resolver.

methods.name: validateHost
methods.description: Validates a hostname by checking if it is allowed, resolving to IP addresses, and ensuring it does not resolve to blocked or special addresses.

methods.name: calculateBlockedAddresses
methods.description: Resolves a list of blocked hostnames into a set of IP addresses, logging warnings if resolution fails.

methods.name: validateHostname
methods.description: Validates a hostname and throws an exception if it is invalid or blocked.
